method.preflight_sequence: Read review-protocol.md and action-first.json only; actually viewed both invitation usage720 images; saved and reread editorial-action-first.json successfully; only then opened packet.json. The initial record was retained unchanged.
method.transcription: Manually read native and actual usage720 renders, then checked each actual thumbnail320. No OCR, source files, embedded text, planning, mappings, prompts, histories or peer reports used. The 47 observed strings were typed from the visible images. Layout line breaks were joined at word boundaries for phrase comparison; visible punctuation was retained.
method.raster_limit: Matching visible punctuation does not certify the underlying Unicode code points of an image. A visible en-dash-like range mark is recorded as an en dash. Pixel review cannot certify actual capacity, fold mechanics, authorship or print suitability.
method.criteria: All seven original protocol anchors are unchanged. Scores are independent integers 1–5; familiar photographic, serif, botanical, collage and line styles are permitted. No preferred material, campaign uniformity, winner or desired score was inferred.
method.nearest_pair_scale: Each closest_pair.diversity is scored independently on the same 1=repeated direction, 3=distinguishable with structural habits, 5=strongly separated directions scale. It is not an image-quality or winner score.
